name: Incubator
title: Incubator: every idea for a new gene or a mutation, in the words it was written in, until it hatches

permissions: keeps the person's ideas for new genes and mutations, each in its original words, with links to where it came from and the history of every change

hands an idea to Gene therapy as a feedback only when the person sets it to Go, where the same converter as every feedback writes its feature request and starts its run when the board builds by itself
reads the workspace to import ideas when asked (rouh-incubator import), and renames each imported task and step with " [in incubator]" through the rename a person's own uses
keeps one chat of the person's for the Incubator, in which the model is told what the list holds

scores every idea with the model on "Scoring the Incubator's ideas" (impact, confidence, frequency, pain, clarity and risk, each with a reason, and suggested stars), from its words, category, status, sources and links, never changing its words or a part or stars the person set

sums every idea up once with the model on "Summing up the Incubator's ideas" (a plain line, its problem, who it helps, what it looks like in use, its vision, its size and the ideas that are the same), kept on the idea and never its words
keeps one chat for each idea the person opens it from, kept with the idea by its number, in which the model is told that idea whole, and the person's feedback in the idea's history and notes
jobs: every fifteen minutes: ideas handed to Gene therapy moved to In build and Built as their requests are (incubator.follow_everyone)
as ideas are added, and every fifteen minutes for any idea without a score: Rouh scores them in batches (incubator_score.queue, incubator_score.sweep)

as ideas are added, and every fifteen minutes for any idea without a summary or whose words changed: Rouh sums them up in batches, those still to decide first (incubator_gist.write, incubator_gist.sweep)
touches.remove: Delete this manifest, rouh/incubator.py, rouh/incubator_import.py, rouh/incubator_score.py and rouh/incubator_gist.py and their uses in modeldefaults.py and model_standard.json, rouh/web/incubator.py, rouh/models/incubator.py, incubatorpage.js and incubatorpage.css, bin/rouh-incubator, the incubator tools in tools.py, the Incubator's chat block in brain.py, its page in evolutionpage.js and its addresses, and drop the tables incubator_ideas and incubator_events with a migration (the gist column with them).
